discovery_notes: Follow-up 2 to packets 260/284, reusing their keys. 30 standard search-snippet queries. New: FiGPiN Marvel Comics Series 2 (#724-729, July 14 2021 inferred), FiGPiN Comic-Con Special Edition 2021 Disney-owned exclusives (C-3PO #783, R2-D2 #784, Hydra Stomper #818, glitter Stitch). Season 2 Dec 2020 drop = 3 pins per FiGPiN. Walmart Funko Mandalorian 2021 members added from hobbyDB but held (linked by retailer/year/count only); 2020 members still unknown. Lock Shock Barrel hold kept and packet 284 link weakened (2019 $10.90 set). Falcon/Wanda dates, Steamboat maker, Bioworld members, Numskull names, Pin Kings year unresolved. No holds released.
